verdict.rationale: Alias or masked-address protection is a fair question for an email client, but the evidence shows no Shortwave feature that creates aliases or masks the user's real address. The only related mention is a community report that Shortwave imported existing Gmail aliases. That is a host-platform (Gmail) capability carried over, not Shortwave's own feature for hiding a real address from sign-ups or strangers.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address
